newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean KFA buys 43,800T soymeal, 4,500T rapemeal.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean KFA buys 43,800T soymeal, 4,500T rapemeal.

text.p: South Korea's Korea Feed Association (KFA) on Tuesday bought 43,800 tonnes of Indian soybean meal and 4,500 tonnes of Indian rapeseed meal in tenders, traders said.
The KFA on Monday invited tenders for 44,500 tonnes of soybean meal and 4,500 tonnes of rapeseed meal.
Traders said the association bought the amount in three positions from three different trading houses --
Position one (22,300 tonnes of soybean meal) from Toepfer at $308.23 a tonne, C&F, for shipment between March 17-April 5, with arrival by April 20 to the port of Inchon.
Position two (13,000 tonnes of soybean meal) from Toshoku Ltd at $309.50 a tonne, C&F, for shipment between March 7-26 with arrival by April 10 to the ports of Ulsan and Kunsan.

Position three (8,500 tonnes of soybean meal and 4,500 tonnes of rapeseed meal) from LG International Corp at $309 a tonne, C&F, for soybean meal and at $147.50 a tonne, C&F, for rapeseed meal for shipment between March 7-26, with arrival by April 10 to the ports of Ulsan and Kunsan.
